intro: Looking for your next escape? Bhutan delivers: dzongs, prayer flags and Tiger's Nest. Here is everything you need to plan a trip.

sections.heading: Why visit Bhutan
paragraphs: Bhutan (South Asia) is known for its mountain, culture and spiritual experiences. Overall it is on the premium side — worth saving up for, though budget options exist.

sections.heading: Best time to go
paragraphs: The best time to visit is March to May and September to November.

faq.q: Where should I stay in Bhutan?
faq.a: Popular choices: Paro for the Tiger's Nest hike; Thimphu for the capital; Punakha for the valley.
